blocks.text: Runbook: pack conveyor jam between stations 8 and 9

This is the working cut for PCF-RB-2024-108 on September 26, 2024. Drew Phelps asked for a written bound after the current path (People tap jams while running to save the rate) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host pack.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on pull the box while it is moving, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

E-stop. Lockout. Then clear. Restart only after Drew or a named backup looks. No reach-in. I am not restating a hallway yes. pull the box while it is moving is out because September 5 near-miss: sleeve in the belt. Drew stopped the line 14 minutes. Sleeve won. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: stations=8-9, minutes=14, miss=1, weeks=2, estop=1, rate=0, sleeve=1, backup=1. Sibling tickets PCF-2166 and PCF-MTG-2024-070. I will not reopen pull the box while it is moving in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: estop.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (21): refuse on pull the box while it is moving, lock is e-stop, lockout, named restart, no reach-in. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2166.
Hands do not go in a moving belt. I do not care how small the jam looks.

What a skeptical lead would try first on pack.pinecrest.internal: the path Drew Phelps actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on conv-08.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
